eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Postmenopausal women
- HER2-negative breast cancer
- ECOG performance status <= 1
- Hemoglobin >= 10 g/dL
- ANC >= 1500 cells/uL
- Platelets >= 100000 /uL
- Creatinine <= 1.5 mg/dL
- No prior CDK4/6 inhibitor

Exclusion Criteria:
- Brain metastases
- Prior palbociclib use
